set: LEGO Technic 42175 Volvo EC230 Electric Excavator (excavator booklet, bags 12-17)

input.model_so_far: The 5 x 7 frame with a pin standing in each corner (step 1).

new_parts.name: uc-beam9-1
new_parts.position: one 9-hole beam over each long side of the frame, sitting on the corner pins

new_parts.name: uc-beam9-2
new_parts.position: one 9-hole beam over each long side of the frame, sitting on the corner pins

what_each_new_part_touches: Each 9-hole beam drops onto two of the corner pins (2nd and 8th hole), leaving one hole of beam hanging out past each end.
where_everything_is_after: the two beams lie parallel on top of the frame's long sides, one hole overhanging at each end

why.problem_solved: Doubles the thickness of the frame's long sides and gives free end holes for the next pins.
why.why_these_parts: A 9-hole beam is two holes longer than the 7-hole frame side, so the corner pins land in holes 2 and 8 and the end holes stay free.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 3 puts pins into those free end holes.

review_note: Which beam holes sit on the pins is worked out from the 1:1 beam picture (9 holes) and the 7-hole frame; the picture does not label them.
